metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali

shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message: But that's the point, they're a gesture, a symbol of our congratulations. My parents always taught me that gestures like these are important, they show you care.
